item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":1,"rationale":"The President requests that the Board chairman prepare recommendations for later presidential carrier designations and identifies considerations for that review. The segment anticipates, but does not itself make, a designation or direct issuance of a particular permit.","evidence":"I am requesting that you submit a recommendation to me by early October"},{"segment_id":"2","code":1,"rationale":"The President requests recommendations concerning possible permit amendments and carrier designations; any legally consequential amendment or designation would occur only after further decision-making.","evidence":"I also request your recommendation on these designations by early October"},{"segment_id":"3","code":1,"rationale":"The President directs expedited recommendations and assigns the Secretaries an internal assistance role in implementing the agreement, without prescribing a specific legal outcome.","evidence":"I have directed the Secretaries of State and Transportation to provide any assistance that you may require"}]}
